🚀 Quick Start Instructions

Step 1: Navigate to the project folder

Step 2: Start backend: cd backend && python -m venv venv && venv\Scripts\activate && pip install -r requirements.txt && uvicorn app.main:app --reload

Step 3: Start frontend: cd frontend && npm install && npm run dev

Step 4: Access at http://localhost:5173
